settings.heading: DETAILS
settings.content:
• 100% cotton. Mid-weight, breathable, built to hold its shape.
  • Oversized unisex silhouette.
  • Graphic artwork developed exclusively for this series.
  • Made for moments, not routines. Designed to last.

settings.heading: FIT NOTE
settings.content: For a more oversized look, size up.

settings.heading: CARE GUIDE
settings.content:
Wash inside out with similar colors and textures. Use a gentle or delicate cycle with cold water and mild detergent.

• Do not wring
• Do not bleach
• Do not iron
• Do not tumble dry
• Air dry only

Follow the care instructions carefully to preserve the quality and character of your piece.

Care, like intention, is what allows things to endure.
